narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000018 — THE DATA COLOSSEUM

Fifty thousand simulated spectators roar as streams of tokens fly.

Tonight the dome hosts Mastering Checklist (domain) against Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer (hybrid). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Pitch a movie about a lighthouse keeper who discovers a signal." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Mastering Checklist steadies a feint of pure logic (59.2 pts). Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer ripples a lightning analogy (63.5 pts). Round to Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer.

ROUND 2: Mastering Checklist opens a lightning analogy (53.7 pts). Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer detonates a cascade of examples (65.3 pts). Round to Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer.

ROUND 3: Mastering Checklist counters a precision strike of clarity (59 pts). Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer counters a cascade of examples (70.6 pts). Round to Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer.

FINAL: Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer defeats Mastering Checklist, 199.4 to 171.9 — a margin of 27.5 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Depth. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer won on The Scholar's Rubric with a 27.5-point margin (199.4 vs 171.9).
Strongest dimension: Depth — Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer's depth carried all three rounds.
Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.

Hybrid vigor confirmed: the fused lineage (Mix-and-match hybrid of Ice Cream Maker (JAH-AI-DOM-222) and Story Writer (JAH-AI-DOM-015). Shared record with the AI Mix Lab.) outperformed both parent archetypes tonight.
Rematch recommendation: run Mastering Checklist against a hybrid contender to isolate the depth gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000018, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer's depth-first drill for "Pitch a movie about a lighthouse keeper wh"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on depth when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Ice Cream Maker x Story Writer's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000018: isolate depth, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
